answer: Every epoch, each identity must register a sealed prediction on a soon-resolving public fact, then reveal it after settlement. Identities that predict truthfully gain weight at a glacier's pace - quartz-hard, one verified layer per epoch, unclonable. A sybil fleet faces a fork: vote honestly and gain nothing extra, or vote as a lying bloc and lose a locked bond on every fake at once. Climbing to the zenith of influence needs months of proven predictions, while minting a thousand keys buys zero weight. Lying multiplies the bond bill, not the power.
